source.title: Divine Liturgy of St. Mark
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Divine Liturgy of St. Mark

paragraphs.text: The Divine Liturgy of the Holy Apostle and Evangelist Mark, The Disciple of the Holy Peter.
Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy.

We give You thanks, yea, more than thanks, O Lord our God, the Father of our Lord and God and Saviour Jesus Christ, for all Your goodness at all times and in all places, because You have shielded, rescued, helped, and guided us all the days of our lives, and brought us unto this hour, permitting us again to stand before You in Your holy place, that we may implore forgiveness of our sins and propitiation to all Your people. We pray and beseech You, merciful God, to grant in Your goodness that we may spend this holy day and all the time of our lives without sin, in fullness of joy, health, safety, holiness, and reverence of You. But all envy, all fear, all temptation, all the influence of Satan, all the snares of wicked men, do You, O Lord, drive away from us, and from Your Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church. Bestow upon us, O Lord, what is good and meet. Whatever sin we commit in thought, word, or deed, do You in Your goodness and mercy be pleased to pardon. Leave us not, O Lord, while we hope in You; nor lead us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one and from his works, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son.
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, in Your most holy, good, and life-giving Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy.

O God, Sovereign Lord, the Father of our Lord and God and Saviour Jesus Christ, we pray and beseech You to grant that our king may enjoy peace, and be just and brave. Subdue under him, O God, all his adversaries and enemies. Gird on your shield and armour, and rise to his aid. Give him the victory, O God, that his heart may be set on peace and the praise of Your holy name, that we too in his peaceful reign may spend a calm and tranquil life in all reverence and godly fear, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son:
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with Your most holy, good, and life-giving Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
Pray for the papas and the bishop.
Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy.

O Sovereign and Almighty God, the Father of our Lord, God, and Saviour Jesus Christ, we pray and beseech You to defend in Your good mercy our most holy and blessed high priest our Father in God <greek>Δ</greek>, and our most reverend Bishop <greek>Δ</greek> . Preserve them for us through many years in peace, while they according to Your holy and blessed will fulfil the sacred priesthood committed to their care, and dispense aright the word of truth; with all the orthodox bishops, elders, deacons, sub-deacons, readers, singers, and laity, with the entire body of the Holy and only Catholic Church. Graciously bestow upon them peace, health, and salvation. The prayers they offer up for us, and we for them, do You, O Lord, receive at Your holy, heavenly, and reasonable altar. But all the enemies of Your Holy Church put speedily under their feet, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son:
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with Your all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
The Priest offers up the prayer of entrance, and for incense.

O Sovereign Lord our God, who hast chosen the lamp of the twelve apostles with its twelve lights, and hast sent them forth to proclaim throughout the whole world and teach the Gospel of Your kingdom, and to heal sickness and every weakness among the people, and hast breathed upon their faces and said unto them, Receive the Holy Spirit the Comforter: whosesoever sins you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whosesoever sins you retain, they are retained: Breathe also Your Holy Spirit upon us Your servants, who, standing around, are about to enter on Your holy service, upon the bishops, elders, deacons, readers, singers, and laity, with the entire body of the Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church.
From the curse and execration, from condemnation, imprisonment, and banishment, and from the portion of the adversary;

Purify our lives and cleanse our hearts from all pollution and from all wickedness, that with pure heart and conscience we may offer to You this incense for a sweet-smelling savour, and for the remission of our sins and the sins of all Your people, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son:
Through whom and with whom be the glory and the power to You, with Your all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
The Gospel is carried in, and the Deacon says:—
The Priest says the prayer of the Trisagion.

O Sovereign Lord Christ Jesus, the co-eternal Word of the eternal Father, who was made in all things like as we are, but without sin, for the salvation of our race; who hast sent forth Your holy disciples and apostles to proclaim and teach the Gospel of Your kingdom, and to heal all disease, all sickness among Your people, be pleased now, O Lord, to send forth Your light and Your truth. Enlighten the eyes of our minds, that we may understand Your divine oracles. Fit us to become hearers, and not only hearers, but doers of Your word, that we, becoming fruitful, and yielding good fruit from thirty to an hundred fold, may be deemed worthy of the kingdom of heaven.

Let Your mercy speedily overtake us, O Lord. For You are the bringer of good tidings, the Saviour and Guardian of our souls and bodies; and we offer glory, thanks, and the Trisagion to You, the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
Amen. Holy God, holy mighty, holy immortal. Holy, holy, holy, etc.
VI. After the Trisagion the Priest makes the sign of the cross over the people, and says:—
Then follow the Let us attend; The Apostle and Prologue of the Hallelujah. The Deacons, after a prescribed form, say:—
May the Lord in His mercy bless and help us, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
The Priest, before the Gospel is read, offers incense, and says:—

Accept at Your holy, heavenly, and reasonable altar, O Lord, the incense we offer in presence of Your sacred glory. Send down upon us in return the grace of Your Holy Spirit, for You are blessed, and let Your glory encircle us.
VII. The Deacon, when he is about to read the Gospel, says:—
May the Lord, who is the blessed God, bless and strengthen us, and make us hearers of His holy Gospel, now, henceforth, and for evermore. Amen.
Stand and let us hear the holy Gospel.
VIII. The Deacon reads the Gospel, and the Priest says the prayer of the Collect.
Look down in mercy and compassion, O Lord, and heal the sick among Your people.
May all our brethren who have gone or who are about to go abroad, safely reach their destination in due season.
Send down the gracious rain upon the thirsty lands, and make the rivers flow in full stream, according to Your grace.
The fruits of the land do You, O Lord, fill with seed and make ripe for the harvest.
In peace, courage, justice, and tranquillity preserve the kingdom of Your servant, whom You have deemed worthy to reign over this land.
From evil days, from famine and pestilence, from the assault of barbarians, defend, O Lord, this Christ-loving city, lowly and worthy of Your compassion, as You spared Nineveh of old.
For You are full of mercy and compassion, and rememberest not the iniquities of men against them.
You have said through Your prophet Isaiah,— I will defend this city, to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

Wherefore we pray and beseech You to defend in Your good mercy this city, for the sake of the martyr and evangelist Mark, who has shown us the way of salvation through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son.
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with Your all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit.
Then they say the verse. The Deacon says— The three.

O Sovereign and Almighty God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, we pray and beseech You to fill our hearts with the peace of heaven, and to bestow moreover the peace of this life. Preserve for us through many years our most holy and blessed Papas <greek>Δ</greek>, and our most pious Bishop <greek>Δ</greek>, while they, according to Your holy and blessed will, peacefully fulfil the holy priesthood committed to their care, and dispense aright the word of truth, with all the orthodox bishops, elders, deacons, sub-deacons, readers, singers, with the entire body of the holy Catholic and Apostolic Church. Bless our meetings, O Lord. Grant that we may hold them without let or hindrance, according to Your holy will. Be pleased to give to us, and Your servants after us for ever, houses of praise and prayer. Rise, O Lord, and let Your enemies be scattered. Let all who hate Your holy name be put to flight. Bless Your faithful and orthodox people. Multiply them by thousands and tens of thousands. Let no deadly sin prevail against them, or against Your holy people, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son.
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with Your all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit.
Take care that none of the catechumens —
X. The Priest offers incense at the entrance, and prays:—
O Lord our God, who lackest nothing, accept this incense offered by an unworthy hand, and deem us all worthy of Your blessing, for You are our sanctification, and we ascribe glory to You.
The holy things are carried to the altar, and the Priest prays thus:—

O holy, highest, awe-inspiring God, who dwellest among the saints, sanctify us, and deem us worthy of Your reverend priesthood. Bring us to Your precious altar with a good conscience, and cleanse our hearts from all pollution. Drive away from us all unholy thoughts, and sanctify our souls and minds. Grant that, with reverence of You, we may perform the service of our holy fathers, and propitiate Your presence through all time; for You are He who blesses and sanctifies all things, and to You we ascribe glory and thanks.
The Priest says the prayer of salutation.

O Sovereign and Almighty Lord, look down from heaven on Your Church, on all Your people, and on all Your flock. Save us all, Your unworthy servants, the sheep of Your fold. Give us Your peace, Your help, and Your love, and send to us the gift of Your Holy Spirit, that with a pure heart and a good conscience we may salute one another with an holy kiss, without hypocrisy, and with no hostile purpose, but guileless and pure in one spirit, in the bond of peace and love, one body and one spirit, in one faith, even as we have been called in one hope of our calling, that we may all meet in the divine and boundless love, in Christ Jesus our Lord, with whom You are blessed.
Then the Priest offers the incense, and says:—

The incense is offered to Your name. Let it ascend, we implore You, from the hands of Your poor and sinful servants to Your heavenly altar for a sweet-smelling savour, and the propitiation of all Your people. For all glory, honour, adoration, and thanks are due unto You, the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, now, henceforth, and for evermore. Amen.
After the Salutation, the Deacon in a loud voice says:—
XII. Stand and make the offering duly.
The Priest, making the sign of the cross over the disks and chalices, says in a loud voice (the Nicene Creed):—
I believe in one God, etc.
Pray for those who present the offering.
The Priest says the prayer of the Oblation.

O Sovereign Lord, Christ Jesus the Word, who art equal in power with the Father and the Holy Spirit, the great high priest; the bread that came down from heaven, and saved our souls from ruin; who gavest Yourself, a spotless Lamb, for the life of the world....

We pray and beseech You, O Lord, in Your mercy, to let Your presence rest upon this bread and these chalices on the all-holy table, while angels, archangels, and Your holy priests stand round and minister for Your glory and the renewing of our souls, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son, through whom and with whom be glory and power to You.
And from the Holy Spirit was He made flesh;
The Priest makes the sign of the cross, and says:—
The Priest makes the sign of the cross again, and says:—
XIII. In like manner also, as after the Creed, he makes the sign of the cross upon the People, and says aloud:—
Let us lift up our hearts.
We lift them up to the Lord.
Let us give thanks to the Lord.

O Lord God, Sovereign and Almighty Father, truly it is meet and right, holy and becoming, and good for our souls, to praise, bless, and thank You; to make open confession to You by day and night with voice, lips, and heart without ceasing;
To You who hast made the heaven, and all that is therein; the earth, and all that is therein; The sea, fountains, rivers, lakes, and all that is therein;
To You who, after Your own image and likeness, has made man, upon whom You also bestowed the joys of Paradise;
And when he trespassed against You, You neither neglected nor forsook him, good Lord,
But recalled him by Your law, instruct him by Your prophets, restore and renew him by this awful, life-giving, and heavenly mystery.
And all this You have done by Your Wisdom and the Light of truth, Your only-begotten Son, our Lord, God, and Saviour Jesus Christ, Through whom, thanking You with Him and the Holy Spirit,

We offer this reasonable and bloodless sacrifice, which all nations, from the rising to the setting of the sun, from the north and the south, present to You, O Lord; for great is Your name among all peoples, and in all places are incense, sacrifice, and oblation offered to Your holy name.

XIV. We pray and beseech You, O lover of men, O good Lord, remember in Your good mercy the Holy and only Catholic and Apostolic Church throughout the whole world, and all Your people, and all the sheep of this fold. Vouchsafe to the hearts of all of us the peace of heaven, but grant us also the peace of this life.
Guide and direct in all peace the king, army, magistrates, councils, peoples, and neighbourhoods, and all our outgoings and incomings.

O King of Peace, grant us Your peace in unity and love. May we be Yours, O Lord; for we know no other God but You, and name no other name but Yours. Give life unto the souls of all of us, and let no deadly sin prevail against us, or against all Your people.
Look down in mercy and compassion, O Lord, and heal the sick among Your people. Deliver them and us, O Lord, from sickness and disease, and drive away the spirit of weakness.
Raise up those who have been long afflicted, and heal those who are vexed with unclean spirits.

Have mercy on all who are in prison, or in mines, or on trial, or condemned, or in exile, or crushed by cruel bondage or tribute. Deliver them, O Lord, for You are our God, who settest the captives free; who raisest up the downtrodden; who givest hope to the hopeless, and help to the helpless; who liftest up the fallen; who givest refuge to the shipwrecked, and vengeance to the oppressed.
Pity, relieve, and restore every Christian soul that is afflicted or wandering.
But You, O Lord — the physician of our souls and bodies, the guardian of all flesh — look down, and by Your saving power heal all the diseases of soul and body.

Guide and prosper our brethren who have gone or who are about to go abroad. Whether they travel by land, or river, or lake, by public road, or in whatever way journeying, bring them everywhere to a safe and tranquil haven. Be pleased to be with them by land and sea, and restore them in health and joy to joyful and healthful homes.
Ever defend, O Lord, our journey through this life from trouble and storm.
Send down rich and copious showers on the dry and thirsty lands.
Gladden and revive the face of the earth, that it may spring forth and rejoice in the raindrops.
Make the waters of the river flow in full stream.
Gladden and revive the face of the earth with the swelling waters.
Fill all the channels of the streams, and multiply the fruits of the earth.
Bless, O Lord, the fruits of the earth, and keep them safe and unharmed. Fill them with seed, and make them ripe for the harvest.

Bless even now, O Lord, Your yearly crown of blessing for the sake of the poor of Your people, the widow, the orphan, and the stranger, and for the sake of all of us who have our hope in You and call upon Your holy name; for the eyes of all are upon You, and You give them bread in due season.
O You who gives food to all flesh, fill our hearts with joy and gladness, that at all times, having all sufficiency, we may abound to every good work in Christ Jesus our Lord.
O King of kings and Lord of lords, defend the kingdom of Your servant, our orthodox and Christ-loving sovereign, whom You have deemed worthy to reign over this land in peace, courage, and justice.

Subdue under him, O Lord, every enemy and adversary, whether at home or abroad. Gird on Your shield and armour, and rise to his aid. Draw Your sword, and help him to fight against them that persecute him. Shield him in the day of battle, and grant that the fruit of his loins may sit upon his throne.

Be kind to him, O Lord, for the sake of Your Holy and Apostolic Church, and all Your Christ-loving people, that we too in his peaceful reign may live a calm and tranquil life, in all reverence and godliness.

O Lord our God, give peace to the souls of our fathers and brethren who have fallen asleep in Jesus, remembering our forefathers of old, our fathers, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, bishops, and the souls of all the holy and just men who have died in the Lord.
Especially remember those whose memory we this day celebrate, and our holy father Mark, the apostle and evangelist, who has shown us the way of salvation.
The Lord will bless you in His grace, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
The Deacon reads the record of the dead.

XV. Give peace, O Sovereign Lord our God, to the souls of all who dwell in the tabernacles of Your saints. Graciously bestow upon them in Your kingdom Your promised blessing, which eye has not seen, and ear has not heard, nor has it entered into the heart of man what You, O God, have prepared for those who love Your holy name. Give peace to their souls, and deem them worthy of the kingdom of heaven.
Grant that we may end our lives as Christians, acceptable unto You and without sin, and be pleased to give us part and lot with all Your saints.

Accept, O God, by Your ministering archangels at Your holy, heavenly, and reasonable altar in the spacious heavens, the thank-offerings of those who offer sacrifice and oblation, and of those who desire to offer much or little, in secret or openly, but have it not to give.
Accept the thank-offerings of those who have presented them this day, as You accepted the gifts of Your righteous Abel:

As You accepted the sacrifice of our father Abraham, the incense of Zacharias, the alms of Cornelius, and the widow's two mites, accept also the thank-offerings of these, and give them for the things of time the things of eternity, and for the things of earth the things of heaven. Defend, O Lord, our most holy and blessed Papas <greek>Δ</greek>, whom You have fore-ordained to rule over Your Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church, and our most pious Bishop <greek>Δ</greek>, that they through many years of peace may, according to Your holy and blessed will, fulfil the sacred priesthood committed to their care, and dispense aright the word of truth.
Remember the orthodox bishops everywhere, the elders, deacons, sub-deacons, readers, singers, monks, virgins, widows, and laity.

Remember, O Lord, the holy city of our God, Jesus Christ; and the imperial city; and this city of ours, and all cities and all lands, and the peace and safety of those who dwell therein in the orthodox faith of Christ.
Be mindful, O Lord, of the return of the back-sliding, and of every Christian soul that is afflicted and oppressed, and in need of Your divine mercy and help.
Be mindful, O Lord, of our brethren in captivity. Grant that they may find mercy and compassion with those who have led them captive.
Be mindful also of us, O Lord, Your sinful and unworthy servants, and blot out our sins in Your goodness and mercy.
Be mindful also of me, Your lowly, sinful, and unworthy servant, and in Your mercy blot out my sins. Be with us, O Lord, who minister unto Your holy name.
Utterly uproot idolatry from the world.
Crush under our feet Satan, and all his wicked influence.
Humble now, as at all times, the enemies of Your Church.
Bring to naught the wicked plots they contrive against us.
Arise, O Lord, and let Your enemies be scattered, and let all who hate Your holy name be put to flight.
Bless a thousand times ten thousand Your faithful and orthodox people while they do Your holy will.
Let those who are seated stand.

Deliver the captive; rescue the distressed feed the hungry; comfort the faint-hearted, convert the erring; enlighten the darkened; raise the fallen; confirm the wavering; heal the sick; and guide them all, good Lord, into the way of salvation, and into Your sacred fold. Deliver us from our iniquities; protect and defend us at all times.

For You are far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but in that which is to come. Round You stand ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands of holy angels and hosts of archangels; and Your two most honoured creatures, the many-eyed cherubim and the six-winged seraphim. With two they cover their faces, and with two they cover their feet, and with two they fly; and they cry one to another for ever with the voice of praise, and glorify You, O Lord, singing aloud the triumphal and thrice-holy hymn to Your great glory:—
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of Sabaoth. Heaven and earth are full of Your glory.
You ever sanctify all men; but with all who glorify You, receive also, O Sovereign Lord, our sanctification, who with them celebrate Your praise, and say:—
The Priest makes the sign of the cross over the sacred mysteries.

XVI. For truly heaven and earth are full of Your glory, through the manifestation of our Lord and God and Saviour Jesus Christ. Fill, O God, this sacrifice with Your blessing, through the inspiration of Your all-holy Spirit. For the Lord Himself, our God and universal King, Christ Jesus, reclining at meat the same night on which He delivered Himself up for our sins and died in the flesh for all, took bread in His holy, pure, and immaculate hands, and lifting His eyes to His Father, our God, and the God of all, gave thanks; and when He had blessed, hallowed, and broken the bread, gave it to His holy and blessed disciples and apostles, saying:—
For this is my body, which is broken for you, and divided for the remission of sins.

After the same manner also, when He had supped, He took the cup of wine mingled with water, and lifting His eyes to You, His Father, our God, and the God of all, gave thanks; and when He had blessed and filled it with the Holy Spirit, gave it to His holy and blessed disciples and apostles, saying:—
For this is my blood of the new testament which is shed for you and for many, and distributed among you for the remission of sins.

This do in remembrance of me; for as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you do show forth my death and acknowledge my resurrection and ascension until I come. O Sovereign and Almighty Lord, King of heaven, while we show forth the death of Your only-begotten Son, our Lord, God, and Saviour Jesus Christ, and acknowledge His blessed resurrection from the dead on the third day, we do also openly declare His ascension into heaven, and His sitting on the right hand of You, God and Father, and await His second terrible and dreadful coming, in which He will come to judge righteously the quick and the dead, and to render to each man according to his works.

XVII. O Lord our God, we have placed before You what is Yours from Your own mercies. We pray and beseech You, O good and merciful God, to send down from Your holy heaven, from the mansion You have prepared, and from Your infinite bosom, the Paraclete Himself, holy, powerful, and life-giving, the Spirit of truth, who spoke in the law, the apostles, and prophets; who is everywhere present, and fills all things, freely working sanctification in whom He will with Your good pleasure; one in His nature; manifold in His working; the fountain of divine blessing; of like substance with You, and proceeding from You; sitting with You on the throne of Your kingdom, and with Your only-begotten Son, our Lord and God and Saviour Jesus Christ. Send down upon us also and upon this bread and upon these chalices Your Holy Spirit, that by His all-powerful and divine influence He may sanctify and consecrate them, and make this bread the body.
And this cup the blood of the new testament, of the very Lord, and God, and Saviour, and universal King Christ Jesus.

That to all of us who partake thereof they may tend unto faith, sobriety, healing, temperance, sanctification, the renewal of soul, body, and spirit, participation in the blessedness of eternal life and immortality, the glory of Your most holy name, and the remission of sins, that Your most holy, precious, and glorious name may be praised and glorified in this as in all things.

O God of light, Father of life, Author of grace, Creator of worlds, Founder of knowledge, Giver of wisdom, Treasure of holiness, Teacher of pure prayers, Benefactor of our souls, who givest to the faint-hearted who put their trust in You those things into which the angels desire to look: O Sovereign Lord, who has brought us up from the depths of darkness to light, who has given us life from death, who has graciously bestowed upon us freedom from slavery, who has scattered the darkness of sin within us, through the presence of Your only-begotten Son, do Thou now also, through the visitation of Your all-holy Spirit, enlighten the eyes of our understanding, that we may partake without fear of condemnation of this heavenly and immortal food, and sanctify us wholly in soul, body, and spirit, that with Your holy disciples and apostles we may say this prayer to You: Our Father who art in heaven, etc.

And grant, O Sovereign Lord, in Your mercy, that we with freedom of speech, without fear of condemnation, with pure heart and enlightened soul, with face that is not ashamed, and with hollowed lips, may venture to call upon You, the holy God who art in heaven, as our Father, and say:—
Our Father who art in heaven, etc.

Verily, Lord, Lord, lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil; for Your abundant mercy shows that we through our great infirmity are unable to resist it. Grant that we may find a way whereby we may be able to withstand temptation; for You have given us power to tread upon serpents, and scorpions, and all the power of the enemy.
For Yours is the kingdom and power.

O Sovereign and Almighty Lord, who sittest upon the cherubim, and art glorified by the seraphim; who has made the heaven out of waters, and adorned it with choirs of stars; who has placed an unbodied host of angels in the highest heavens to sing Your praise for ever; before You have we bowed our souls and bodies in token of our bondage. We beseech You to repel the dark assaults of sin from our understanding, and to gladden our minds with the divine radiance of Your Holy Spirit, that, filled with the knowledge of You, we may worthily partake of the mercies set before us, the pure body and precious blood of Your only-begotten Son, our Lord and God and Saviour Jesus Christ. Pardon all our sins in Your abundant and unsearchable goodness, through the grace, mercy, and love of Your only-begotten Son:
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with the all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit.

O holy, highest, awe-inspiring God, who dwellest among the saints, sanctify us by the word of Your grace and by the inspiration of Your all-holy Spirit; for You have said, O Lord our God, Be holy; for I am holy. O Word of God, past finding out, consubstantial and co-eternal with the Father and the Holy Spirit, and sharer of their sovereignty, accept the pure song which cherubim and seraphim, and the unworthy lips of Your sinful and unworthy servant, sing aloud.
Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy; Lord, have mercy.
One Father holy, one Son holy, one Spirit holy, in the unity of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
The Priest makes the sign of the cross upon the people, and says in a loud voice:—
The Priest breaks the bread, and says:—
The Priest divides it among those present, and says:—
The Lord will bless and help you through His great mercy.
The Holy Spirit commands and sanctifies.
Lo, they are sanctified and consecrated.
The Lord Himself has blessed it.
As the hart pants after the water-brooks, etc.
When he gives the bread to the clergy, he says:—
And when he gives the chalice, he says:—
The precious blood of our Lord, and God, and Saviour.
After the service is completed, the Deacon says:—
The Priest says the prayer of thanksgiving.

O Sovereign Lord our God, we thank You that we have partaken of Your holy, pure, immortal, and heavenly mysteries, which You have given for our good, and for the sanctification and salvation of our souls and bodies. We pray and beseech You, O Lord, to grant in Your good mercy, that by partaking of the holy body and precious blood of Your only-begotten Son, we may have faith that is not ashamed, love that is unfeigned, fullness of holiness, power to eschew evil and keep Your commandments, provision for eternal life, and an acceptable defence before the awful tribunal of Your Christ:
Through whom and with whom be glory and power to You, with Your all-holy, good, and life-giving Spirit.
The Priest then turns to the people, and says:—

XXII. O mightiest King, co-eternal with the Father, who by Your might has vanquished hell and trodden death under foot, who has bound the strong man, and by Your miraculous power and the enlightening radiance of Your unspeakable Godhead has raised Adam from the tomb, send forth Your invisible right hand, which is full of blessing, and bless us all.
Pity us, O Lord, and strengthen us by Your divine power.
Take away from us the sinful and wicked influence of carnal desire.
Let the light shine into our souls, and dispel the surrounding darkness of sin.

Unite us to the all-blessed assembly that is well-pleasing unto You; for through You and with You, all praise, honour, power, adoration, and thanksgiving are due unto the Father and the Holy Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
In the name of the Lord.
XXIII. The love of God the Father; the grace of the Son, our Lord Jesus Christ; the communion and gift of the All-holy Spirit, be with us all, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
Amen. Blessed be the name of the Lord.
The Priest prays in the sacristy, and says:—

O Lord, You have given us sanctification by partaking of the all-holy body and precious blood of Your only-begotten Son; give us the grace and gift of the All-holy Spirit. Enable us to lead blameless lives; and guide us unto the perfect redemption, and adoption, and the everlasting joys of the world to come. For You are our sanctification, and we ascribe glory unto You, the Father, and the Son, and the All-holy Spirit, now, henceforth, and for evermore.
May God bless, who blesses and sanctifies, who defends and preserves us all through the partaking of His holy mysteries; and who is blessed for ever. Amen.

latex.p0003: \Emph{圣宗徒兼福音作者\Person{马尔谷}，\Person{圣伯多禄}之门徒的神圣礼仪。}
latex.p0013: 我们感谢祢，甚至超过感谢，哦主我们的天主，我们主、天主和救主耶稣基督的圣父，为了祢一切良善，时时处处，因为祢护佑、拯救、帮助、引导我们一生所有的日子，并带领我们到了这个时辰，允许我们再次站在祢面前，在祢的圣所，祈求我们罪的赦免和祢全体百姓的赎罪。我们祈求并恳求祢，仁慈的天主，求祢恩赐我们在这圣日和我们一生所有的时间，无罪恶地度过，充满喜乐、健康、安全、圣洁和对祢的敬畏。但是一切嫉妒、一切恐惧、一切诱惑、一切撒殚的影响、一切恶人的网罗，哦主，求祢从我们身上驱除，并从祢的圣而公宗徒教会驱除。赐予我们，哦主，良善和适宜的事。无论我们在思想、言语或行为上所犯的罪，求祢因祢的良善和仁慈乐意宽恕。不要离弃我们，哦主，当我们仰望祢时；也不要让我们陷于诱惑，但救我们脱离那恶者及其作为，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈爱和仁爱。
latex.p0015: 藉着祂，并与祂，荣耀和权能归于祢，在祢至圣、良善、赋予生命的圣神内，从今时直到永远。
latex.p0027: 哦天主，上主君王，我们主、天主和救主耶稣基督的圣父，我们祈求并恳求祢，赐我们的君王享受和平，并公义、勇敢。求祢制服他的一切对头和仇敌，哦天主。求祢佩上盾牌和甲胄，起来帮助他。赐他胜利，哦天主，使他的心专注于和平和颂扬祢的圣名，使我们也在他和平的统治下，以一切敬畏和虔诚度过宁静安定的生活，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈爱和仁爱。
latex.p0029: 藉着祂，并与祂，荣耀和权能归于祢，与祢至圣、良善、赋予生命的圣神，从今时直到永远。
latex.p0041: 哦上主全能的天主，我们主、天主和救主耶稣基督的圣父，我们祈求并恳求祢，以祢的仁慈护佑我们至圣而可敬的大司祭，我们在天主内的圣父\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}，和我们最可敬的主教\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}。求祢保祐他们多年平安，使他们按祢神圣可称颂的旨意，完成托付给他们的神圣司祭职，并正确分配真理之言；连同所有正统的主教、长老、执事、副执事、读经者、歌咏者和平信徒，以及神圣而唯一的公教会全体。仁慈地赐予他们平安、健康与救恩。他们为我们献上的祈祷，以及我们为他们献上的祈祷，哦主，求祢收纳于祢神圣、天上的理性祭台。但将祢圣教会的一切仇敌速速践于他们脚下，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈爱和仁爱。
latex.p0043: 藉着祂，并与祂，荣耀和权能归于祢，与祢全圣、良善、赋予生命的圣神，从今时直到永远。
latex.p0054: \Emph{司铎献上进堂祷及为乳香的祈祷。}
latex.p0056: 哦上主我们的天主，祢拣选了十二宗徒的灯盏，带着十二盏光，派遣他们到整个世界去宣讲并教导祢天国的福音，医治百姓各种疾病和一切软弱，并向他们的脸吹气，对他们说：\BibleQuote{你们领受圣神护慰者：你们赦免谁的罪，就给谁赦免；你们保留谁的罪，就给谁保留。}求祢也将祢的圣神吹在我们这些祢的仆人身上，我们环绕站立，将进入祢的神圣事奉，即主教、长老、执事、读经者、歌咏者和平信徒，及圣而公宗徒教会全体。
latex.p0057: 从咒诅和咒骂，从定罪、监禁、流放，从仇敌的份中；
latex.p0059: 洁净我们的生命，从一切污秽和邪恶中洁净我们的心，好使我们以纯洁的心和良心，向祢献上这乳香，作为馨香的芬芳，并为赦免我们的罪和祢所有百姓的罪，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈爱和仁爱。
latex.p0061: 藉着祂，并与祂，荣耀和权能归于祢，与祢全圣、良善、赋予生命的圣神，从今时直到永远。
latex.p0079: 主上主基督耶稣，永恒圣父的同永圣言，为拯救我们人类，在一切事上成了与我们相似，只是没有罪；祢派遣了祢的圣门徒和宗徒去宣讲并教导祢国度的福音，并医治祢子民中的一切疾病、一切软弱。求祢如今，主啊，发出祢的光明和真理。开启我们心智的眼睛，使我们能理解祢神圣的启示。使我们堪当成为听众，不仅听，而且行祢的话，好使我们结出果实，从三十倍到一百倍，结出美果，堪得天国。
latex.p0081: 愿祢的仁慈速速降临于我们，主啊。因为祢是喜讯的带来者，我们灵魂和身体的救主与守护者；我们将光荣、感谢和\OriginalTerm{三圣颂}{Trisagion}归于祢——圣父、圣子、圣神，从现在到永远。
latex.p0083: 阿们。圣天主，圣全能者，圣永生者。圣、圣、圣，等等。
latex.p0084: \Emph{六、三圣颂后，司铎向信众划十字圣号，并说：——}
latex.p0088: \Emph{然后接着\Quote{请留心}；宗徒书及阿肋路亚序。执事们按预定格式说：——}
latex.p0091: 愿主慈悲地降福并帮助我们，从现在到永远。
latex.p0092: \Emph{司铎在宣读福音前献香并说：——}
latex.p0093: 主，求祢在祢神圣、属天、理性的祭台上接纳我们在祢荣耀面前所献的香。求祢赐给我们祢圣神的恩宠，因为祢应受赞美，愿祢的荣耀环绕我们。
latex.p0097: 愿主，那应受赞美的天主，降福并坚强我们，使我们成为祂圣福音的听众，从现在到永远。阿们。
latex.p0104: \Emph{八、执事宣读福音，司铎念集祷经。}
latex.p0105: 主，求祢以慈悲和怜悯垂顾，医治祢子民中的病人。
latex.p0106: 愿我们所有已出发或即将远行的弟兄，都安全地按时到达目的地。
latex.p0107: 求祢降下及时的雨水在干渴的大地上，使江河满溢，按祢的恩宠。
latex.p0108: 主，求祢使地上的果实充满籽粒，并使之成熟待收。
latex.p0109: 求祢在平安、勇气、正义与安宁中保护祢仆人的王国，祢曾使他堪当统治这片土地。
latex.p0110: 主，求祢拯救这座爱基督的城市，卑微而堪受怜悯，脱离恶日、饥荒、瘟疫和蛮族的攻击，正如祢昔日宽赦了尼尼微。
latex.p0111: 因为祢满有怜悯与慈悲，不记念人的过犯。
latex.p0112: 祢曾通过祢的先知\Person{依撒意亚}说：\BibleQuote{我要保卫这城，为我自己并为我仆达味的缘故拯救它。}
latex.p0113: 因此我们祈求并恳求祢，因殉道者和福音作者\Person{马尔谷}的缘故，以祢的仁慈保卫这城，他藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈悲和爱，向我们指示了救恩之路。
latex.p0115: 藉着祂并偕同祂，光荣与权能归于祢，连同祢至圣、美善、赋予生命的圣神。
latex.p0120: 主上主，全能的天主，我们的主耶稣基督之父，我们祈求并恳求祢以天上的平安充满我们的心，并赐予今生的平安。求祢为我们多年保存我们至圣可敬的教宗\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}，以及我们最虔诚的主教\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}，使他们按祢神圣可敬的旨意，平安地完成所托付的圣职，并正确地传布真理之言，与所有正统的主教、长老、执事、副执事、读经者、歌咏者，以及整个神圣的公教会和宗徒传下来的教会团体。主，请降福我们的聚会。求祢使我们能按祢神圣的旨意，毫无阻碍地举行聚会。求祢乐意赐给我们，并永远赐给祢以后的仆人，赞美和祈祷的殿宇。主，求祢兴起，使祢的仇敌四散。愿所有仇恨祢圣名的人都逃遁。求祢降福祢忠信而正统的子民。使他们千万倍地增加。愿没有致命的罪胜过他们或祢的圣民，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、慈悲和爱。
latex.p0122: 藉着祂并偕同祂，光荣与权能归于祢，连同祢至圣、美善、赋予生命的圣神。
latex.p0130: 注意，不得有任何候洗者——
latex.p0133: \Emph{十、司铎在进堂时献香并祈祷：——}
latex.p0134: 主，我们的天主，祢一无所缺，求祢接纳这不配之手所献的香，并使我们众人堪受祢的降福，因为祢是我们的圣化者，我们将光荣归于祢。
latex.p0135: \Emph{圣物被抬到祭台，司铎如此祈祷：——}
latex.p0136: 圣哉、至高、可敬畏的天主，祢居住在圣者之中，求祢圣化我们，并使我们堪当祢可敬的司祭职。求祢引领我们以良好的良心到祢宝贵的祭台前，洁净我们的心思远离一切污秽。驱除我们所有不洁的思念，圣化我们的灵魂和心智。求祢使我们常怀敬畏之心，举行我们圣父们的礼仪，并时时平息祢的临在；因为祢是降福并圣化万物的那一位，我们将光荣与感谢归于祢。
latex.p0140: 至尊全能的主，求祢从天上垂顾祢的教会、祢的全体子民和祢的整个羊群。拯救我们众人，祢不配的仆人，祢羊栈的羊。赐给我们祢的平安、祢的帮助和祢的慈爱，并派遣祢圣神的恩赐给我们，使我们能以纯洁的心和良好的良心，用圣吻彼此致候，毫不伪善，没有敌意，而是无欺诈、纯洁地同属一个心神，在和平与爱德的联系中，一个身体和一个心神，同一信德，正如我们蒙召于同一望德的召叫，好使我们众人都在基督耶稣我们的主内，与祢同受赞颂的，相遇在那神圣而无尽的爱中。
latex.p0142: 乳香是向祢的名献上的。我们恳求祢，愿它从祢可怜而卑微的仆人之手，升到祢天上的祭台前，成为甘饴的馨香，并为祢全体子民的赎罪。因为一切荣耀、尊崇、朝拜和感谢都归于祢：圣父、圣子及圣神，从今世直到永远。阿们。
latex.p0144: XII. 请站立并适当奉献。
latex.p0145: \Emph{司铎在饼盘和圣爵之上画十字圣号，高声念诵（尼西亚信经）：—}
latex.p0154: 至尊的主，基督耶稣圣言，祢与圣父和圣神同享权能，是伟大的大司祭；是自天降下的食粮，拯救了我们的灵魂免于丧亡；祢将自己作为无玷的羔羊，为世界的生命而献出……
latex.p0155: 我们祈祷并恳求祢，主啊，求祢仁慈地，使祢的临在停留在这些饼和圣爵上，在这至圣的祭台上，同时天使、总领天使和祢的圣司铎们侍立并服役，为祢的荣耀和我们灵魂的更新，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、仁慈和慈爱，藉着祂并与祂一起，荣耀和权能归于祢。
latex.p0163: \Emph{XIII. 同样，在信经之后，他向人民画十字圣号，并高声说：—}
latex.p0176: 上主天主，至尊全能的圣父，确实，这是理所当然、神圣、合宜且有益于我们灵魂的，要日夜不停以声音、嘴唇和心灵赞美、称颂和感谢祢；
latex.p0177: 向祢——祢创造了天及其中的万物；地及其中的万物；海、泉源、江河、湖泊及其中的万物；
latex.p0178: 向祢——祢按自己的肖像和模样造了人，并赐给他乐园的喜乐；
latex.p0179: 当他得罪了祢，祢既没有忽视也没有弃绝他，良善的主，
latex.p0180: 却藉着祢的法律召回他，藉着祢的先知训导他，藉着这可畏的、赋予生命的、天上的奥迹恢复并更新他。
latex.p0181: 这一切祢都藉着祢的智慧与真理之光，即祢的独生子、我们的主、天主和救主耶稣基督完成了。藉着祂，与祂及圣神一起感谢祢，
latex.p0182: 我们向祢，主啊，献上这合理的、无血的祭献，从日出之地到日落之处，从北方到南方，万民都向祢呈献；因为祢的名在万民中何其伟大，在各处都有人向祢的圣名献上乳香、祭献和供品。
latex.p0183: XIV. 我们祈祷并恳求祢，爱人的主，良善的主，求祢以仁慈纪念普世圣而公唯一的、从宗徒传下来的教会，以及祢的全体子民和这羊栈的所有羊只。求祢赐给我们众人内心的天上平安，但也赐给我们此生的平安。
latex.p0184: 求祢引导并治理君王、军队、官长、议会、民众和邻里，及我们一切出入，使之平安。
latex.p0185: 和平之王，求祢在合一与爱德中赐给我们祢的平安。愿我们属于祢，主啊；因为我们不认识别的神，只认识祢，也不提名别的名，只提祢的名。求祢赐生命给我们众人的灵魂，勿让致命的罪胜过我们，或胜过祢的全体子民。
latex.p0186: 主啊，求祢以仁慈和怜悯垂顾，医治祢子民中的病人。求祢拯救他们和我们，主啊，脱离疾病和灾殃，驱散软弱之灵。
latex.p0187: 求祢扶起久病的人，医治被邪魔纠缠的人。
latex.p0188: 求祢怜悯所有在监牢、矿坑、受审、被定罪、流放、被残酷奴役或苛税压迫的人。求祢拯救他们，主啊，因为祢是我们的天主，是释放囚犯者，扶起被压制者，给绝望者希望，给无助者帮助，扶起跌倒者，赐给遇难者避难所，赐给受压迫者伸冤。
latex.p0189: 求祢怜悯、安慰并恢复每一个受苦或迷失的基督徒灵魂。
latex.p0190: 但是祢，主啊——我们灵魂和身体的医师，所有血肉的守护者——求祢垂顾，以祢拯救的大能医治所有灵魂和身体的疾病。
latex.p0191: 求祢引导并祝福已出外或即将出外的弟兄。无论他们走陆路、河流、湖泊、公路，或以任何方式旅行，求祢带他们处处平安到达安稳的港口。求祢与他们同在，无论陆路或海路，并使他们健康愉快地回到愉快健康的家园。
latex.p0192: 主啊，求祢常保护我们此生的旅程免于患难和风暴。
latex.p0193: 求祢降下丰沛的甘霖在干旱贫瘠之地。
latex.p0194: 求祢使大地欢欣复苏，使它在雨点中发芽喜乐。
latex.p0196: 求祢用涨溢的水使大地欢欣复苏。
latex.p0197: 求祢填满所有溪流的河道，并使地上的出产增多。
latex.p0198: 主啊，求祢祝福大地的出产，保护它们安全无虞。求祢使它们籽粒饱满，成熟待收。
latex.p0199: 求主如今也祝福祢因祢子民的贫穷人、寡妇、孤儿和旅客，并因我们所有仰望祢、呼求祢圣名的人而赐下的年度恩泽之冠，因为众目都仰望祢，祢按时赐给他们粮食。
latex.p0200: 祢赐食物给一切有血肉的，求祢使我们的心充满喜乐和欢欣，好使我们常常凡事充足，能多行各样善事，因我们的主耶稣基督。
latex.p0201: 万王之王，万主之主，求祢护卫祢仆人、我们信奉正统信仰、热爱基督的君王的国度，祢曾使他堪当在这土地上以和平、勇气和正义统治。
latex.p0202: 求主将一切仇敌和敌人，无论是家内的还是国外的，都制服在他脚下。求祢执起盾牌和甲胄，起来援助他。拔出祢的剑，帮助他攻击那迫害他的人。在争战之日庇护他，并赐他后裔能坐在他的宝座上。
latex.p0203: 求主因祢的圣而宗徒的教会，并因所有热爱基督的子民，恩待他，好使我们也能在他和平的统治下，以一切虔诚和敬虔，度安宁平静的生活。
latex.p0204: 主、我们的天主，求祢赐平安给那些在耶稣内安眠的我们祖先和弟兄的灵魂，记念我们古时的祖先、教父、圣祖、先知、宗徒、殉道者、宣信者、主教，以及所有在主内去世的圣善义人的灵魂。
latex.p0205: 特别记念我们今日所庆祝其纪念的诸位，以及我们圣教父马尔谷——宗徒兼福音作者，他给我们指示了救恩之路。
latex.p0209: 主要因祂的恩宠降福你们，从今时直到永远。
latex.p0212: 十五、主、主宰的天主，求祢赐平安给所有居住在祢圣徒帐幕中的灵魂。求祢仁慈地在祢的国度中赐给他们祢所预许的福分，就是眼所未见，耳所未闻，人心也未曾想到的：祢、天主，为爱祢圣名的人所预备的。求祢赐平安给他们的灵魂，并使他们堪当承受天国。
latex.p0213: 求祢使我们能以基督徒的方式，中悦于祢、无罪的终结此生，并乐意将一份和一分与祢的众圣徒同赐给我们。
latex.p0214: 天主，求祢藉祢的服役总领天使，在祢崇高、属天、理性的祭台前，在广阔的高天，收纳那些献祭和供物者的感恩祭，以及那些愿意献上或多或少的、或在暗中或公开的、却没有可献之人的心意。
latex.p0215: 求祢收纳那些今日献上感恩祭者的供献，如同祢收纳了祢义人亚伯尔的礼物：
latex.p0217: 如同祢收纳了我们先祖亚巴郎的祭献、匝加利亚的馨香、科尔乃略的施舍和寡妇的两个小钱，也求祢收纳这些人的感恩祭，并赐给他们：以暂时的事物换来永恒的事物，以地上的事物换来天上的事物。主，求祢护卫我们至圣而可敬的教父\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}，祢曾预定了他来治理祢的圣而公宗徒教会，以及我们最虔诚的主教\OriginalTerm{Δ}{Δ}，使他们能依照祢圣善蒙福的旨意，在长久的和平中，完成托付给他们的神圣司祭职，并正确分施真理之言。
latex.p0218: 求祢记念各处正教的主教、长老、执事、副执事、读经员、歌咏员、隐修士、贞女、寡妇和平信徒。
latex.p0219: 主，求祢记念我们天主的圣城——耶稣基督，以及帝都，和我们的这座城，并所有的城和地域，以及按基督正教信仰居住其中之人的和平与安全。
latex.p0220: 主，求祢记念背道者的回归，以及每一个受苦、受压迫、需要祢神圣仁慈和帮助的基督徒灵魂。
latex.p0221: 主，求祢记念我们在囚禁中的弟兄。求祢使他们在俘掳他们的人面前获得怜悯和同情。
latex.p0222: 主，也求祢记念我们这些有罪和不配的仆人，并因祢的良善和仁慈涂抹我们的过犯。
latex.p0223: 也求祢记念我——祢卑微、有罪和不配的仆人，并因祢的仁慈涂抹我的过犯。主，求祢与事奉祢圣名的我们同在。
latex.p0224: 主，求祢降福我们的聚会。
latex.p0225: 将偶像崇拜从世界上彻底根除。
latex.p0226: 将撒殚及其一切邪恶势力践踏在我们脚下。
latex.p0227: 如今，如同时时，求祢贬抑祢教会的仇敌。
latex.p0230: 使他们针对我们所设的恶谋归于无有。
latex.p0231: 主，求祢兴起，愿祢的仇敌四散，愿所有恼恨祢圣名的人都逃遁。
latex.p0232: 求祢千千万万倍地降福祢忠诚而正教的子民，当他们承行祢圣意的时候。
latex.p0236: 释放被掳的；救援受困的；喂养饥饿的；安慰心灰意冷的；使迷途的归正；光照黑暗的；扶起跌倒的；坚固动摇的；医治患病的；并引导他们众人，良善的主，进入救恩之路和祢神圣的羊栈。救我们脱离我们的过犯；时时保护并护佑我们。
latex.p0240: 因为祢远超乎一切宰制、权能、德能、主权，以及一切可称呼的名号，不但在今世，也在来世。有千千万万、万千上万的天使和总领天使的军旅侍立在祢周围；还有祢最尊贵的两种造物：多眼的\OriginalTerm{革鲁宾}{χερουβίμ}和六翼的\OriginalTerm{塞拉芬}{σεραφίμ}。他们用两翼遮面，两翼遮脚，两翼飞翔；他们互相欢呼，永远用赞美的声音歌颂祢，向祢、上主，高唱凯旋和三圣颂，归光荣于祢的尊威：——
latex.p0241: 圣、圣、圣，万军的上主天主。天地充满祢的光荣。
latex.p0243: 祢常圣化众人；但主、主宰，求祢与一切光荣祢者一起，也收纳我们偕同他们所献的颂赞，并与他们同声说：——
latex.p0246: \Quote{司祭在神圣奥迹上画十字圣号。}
latex.p0247: 十六、因为天地确实充满了祢的荣耀，藉着我们的主、天主和救主\Person{耶稣基督}的显现。天主啊，求祢藉着祢至圣圣神的感动，用祢的祝福充满这祭献。因为主自身，我们的天主和普世君王，\Person{基督耶稣}，在祂为我们的罪而交付自己、并为众人按肉身而死的那一夜，坐席时，用祂神圣、纯洁、无玷的手拿起饼，举目向祂的父、我们的天主、万有的天主，祝谢了；当祂祝福、祝圣、擘开饼后，递给祂神圣而蒙福的门徒和宗徒，说：——
latex.p0253: 这是我的身体，为你们所擘开，并为赦免罪过而分赐的。\BibleRef{格前 11:24}
latex.p0257: 同样，晚餐后，祂拿起搀水的酒杯，举目向祢，祂的父、我们的天主、万有的天主，祝谢了；当祂祝福并用圣神充满后，递给祂神圣而蒙福的门徒和宗徒，说：——
latex.p0263: 这是我的血，新盟约的血，为你们和众人流出的，并为赦免罪过而分赐给你们的。\BibleRef{玛 26:28}
latex.p0267: 你们要这样做来纪念我；因为你们每次吃这饼、喝这杯，就是宣告我的死亡，承认我的复活和升天，直到我来临。上主全能的天主，天上的君王，我们宣告祢独生子、我们的主、天主和救主\Person{耶稣基督}的死亡，承认祂第三日从死者中蒙福的复活，也公开宣示祂升天，坐在祢、天主和父的右边，并等候祂第二次可畏而可惧的来临，那时祂将公义地审判生者死者，按照各人的行为报应各人。\BibleRef{格前 11:24-26}
latex.p0268: 主、我们的天主，我们已将属于祢的从祢的仁慈中摆在祢面前。我们祈祷并恳求祢，良善而仁慈的天主，求祢从祢神圣的天上，从祢预备的居所，从祢无限的怀中，派遣\OriginalTerm{护慰者}{Paraclete}祂自己，神圣、有力、赋予生命的真理之神，祂曾在法律、宗徒和先知中发言；祂无所不在，充满万有，按祢的美意自由地在祂所愿意的人中工作圣化；祂本性唯一，工作多样；神圣祝福的泉源；与祢同体，并由祢发出；与祢同坐于祢王国的宝座上，并与祢的独生子、我们的主、天主和救主\Person{耶稣基督}。求祢也派遣祢的圣神降临到我们身上，降临到这饼和这些杯上，使祂以全能而神圣的影响圣化和祝圣它们，并使这饼成为身体。
latex.p0272: 而这杯是用新盟约的血，来自主、天主、救主和普世君王\Person{基督耶稣}。\BibleRef{玛 26:28}
latex.p0276: 为使所有领受这些的人，能获致信德、清醒、痊愈、节制、圣化、灵魂、肉身和精神的更新，参与永生与不朽的真福，祢至圣之名的光荣，以及罪的赦免，使祢至圣、宝贵、荣耀的名，在这事上并在一总事上，得受赞美和光荣。
latex.p0284: 光明的天主，生命之父，恩宠的创作者，世界的创造者，知识的奠基者，智慧的赐予者，圣德的宝藏，纯洁祈祷的导师，我们灵魂的恩主，祢赐给投靠祢的怯弱者那些天使也渴望观看的事物：上主、君王，祢从黑暗深处将我们领到光明，从死亡中赐给我们生命，恩赐我们脱离奴役的自由，藉着祢独生子的临在，驱散我们内里罪的黑暗，求祢如今也藉着祢至圣圣神的来临，照亮我们理智的眼目，使我们能无恐于定罪地分受这天上的不朽食物，并完全圣化我们的灵魂、肉身和精神，使我们可以与祢神圣的门徒和宗徒一起向祢献上这祈祷：我们的天父，祢在天上，等等。\BibleRef{玛 6:9-13}
latex.p0286: 上主、君王，求祢仁慈地恩准我们，得以放心大胆、无恐于定罪、以纯洁的心和光明的灵魂、无愧的面容和圣化的嘴唇，敢称祢、天上的圣天主为父，并说：——
latex.p0288: 我们的天父，祢在天上，等等。\BibleRef{玛 6:9}
latex.p0290: 是的，主，主，求祢不要让我们陷于诱惑，但救我们脱离凶恶；因为祢丰厚的仁慈显示，我们因极大的软弱不能抵抗它。求祢赐我们找到一条路，使我们能抵挡诱惑；因为祢已赐给我们权柄，践踏蛇和蝎子，并敌人一切的力量。\BibleRef{玛 6:13}\BibleRef{路 10:19}
latex.p0292: 因为国度与权柄是祢的。\BibleRef{玛 6:13}
latex.p0302: 上主全能的天主，祢坐于革鲁宾之上，受色辣芬赞美；祢从水中造了天，并以星辰的队列装饰它；祢在至高天上安置了无体的天使军旅，永远歌唱赞美祢；在祢面前，我们屈身灵魂和肉身，作为我们臣服的标记。我们恳求祢从我们的理智中驱逐罪的黑暗攻击，并以祢圣神的神圣光辉使我们的心神喜乐，使我们充满对祢的认识，堪当分受摆在面前的仁慈，即祢独生子、我们的主、天主和救主\Person{耶稣基督}的纯洁身体和宝贵宝血。求祢因祢丰厚难测的良善，赦免我们所有的罪，藉着祢独生子的恩宠、仁慈和爱：
latex.p0304: 藉著祂並偕同祂，榮耀與權能歸於禰，偕同至聖、良善、賦予生命的聖神。
latex.p0310: \Quote{至聖、至高、可敬畏的天主，禰居住在聖人中間，求禰以禰恩寵的聖言和禰至聖聖神的感動聖化我們；因為禰曾說過，主、我們的天主：\BibleQuote{你們要成為聖的，因為我是聖的。}天主聖言，尋覓不透，與聖父和聖神\OriginalTerm{同體}{consubstantial}、\OriginalTerm{同永恆}{co-eternal}，並共享治權，求禰接納革魯賓和色辣芬，以及禰有罪而不配僕人的不配嘴唇所高唱的純潔詩歌。}
latex.p0312: 主，求你垂憐；主，求你垂憐；主，求你垂憐。
latex.p0316: 一位聖父是聖的，一位聖子是聖的，一位聖神是聖的，在聖神的合一內。阿們。
latex.p0319: \Emph{司鐸在民眾身上劃十字聖號，並高聲說：——}
latex.p0324: 願主因祂的宏恩祝福並幫助你們。
latex.p0330: 看，它們已被聖化並祝聖。
latex.p0343: \Emph{當他將餅交給聖職人員時，說：——}
latex.p0346: 我們的主、天主、救主的寶血。
latex.p0355: 主、我們的天主，我們感謝禰，因我們領受了禰神聖、純潔、不朽、天上的奧蹟，這是禰為我們的好處，為聖化並拯救我們的靈魂和身體而賜予的。我們祈禱並懇求禰，主，因禰的良善仁慈，恩賜我們藉著領受禰獨生子的聖體寶血，得以擁有不致羞愧的信德、真誠的愛德、圓滿的聖德、避惡守誡的能力、永生的預備，並在禰基督的可畏審判座前得到可悅納的辯護：
latex.p0357: 藉著祂並偕同祂，榮耀與權能歸於禰，偕同禰的至聖、良善、賦予生命的聖神。
latex.p0359: 二十二、至大君王，與聖父同永恆，禰以能力戰勝了地獄，踐踏了死亡，捆綁了壯士，並以禰奇蹟般的大能和禰不可言喻的天主性的啟迪光輝，將亞當從墳墓中舉起，求禰伸出禰滿有祝福的不可見右手，祝福我們眾人。
latex.p0360: 主，求禰憐憫我們，並以禰的神力堅固我們。
latex.p0361: 求禰從我們身上除去肉慾的罪惡與邪惡影響。
latex.p0362: 願光照進我們的靈魂，驅散四圍的罪惡黑暗。
latex.p0363: 求禰使我們與那全蒙祝福、中悅禰的集會聯合；因為藉著禰並偕同禰，一切讚頌、尊榮、權能、欽崇、感謝，都歸於聖父和聖神，自今、永世、及世之世。
latex.p0369: 二十三、天主聖父的愛；聖子、我們的主耶穌基督的恩寵；至聖聖神的共融與恩賜，與我們眾人同在，自今、永世、及世之世。
latex.p0373: 主，禰藉著領受禰獨生子的至聖身體和寶血，賜予我們聖化；求禰賜予我們至聖聖神的恩寵和恩賜。使我們能度無可指責的生活；引領我們達致完美的救贖、義子的名分，以及來世永恆的喜樂。因為禰是我們的聖化，我們將光榮歸於禰、聖父、聖子、及至聖聖神，自今、永世、及世之世。
latex.p0381: 願天主祝福，祂祝福並聖化，因我們領受祂的神聖奧蹟而保衛並保守我們眾人；祂永受讚頌。阿們。
